subject: Autovectorization in-source quickfixes
perf_evidence: Commit explicitly adjusts source annotations and expressions to improve Clang/GCC autovectorization.
change_summary: Changes XXH3 inlining, ARMv7 NEON mid-size handling and scalar long-multiply code generation.

units.name: public XXH3 64/128-bit fixed mid-size and long-input paths, x86 scalar and x86-64-v3
units.evidence: Six fixed-length public targets pass bidirectional Alive2 in scalar x86; the corresponding six x86-64-v3 targets also pass in r_api_v3.

units.name: public XXH3 64-bit 200/240-byte ARMv7 NEON paths
units.evidence: Three ARMv7 NEON public targets pass both directions with vectorization disabled; the same three pass with vectorization enabled in r_arm_neon_vec.

notes: The finite lengths sample changed mid-size and long paths, not every input length or compiler. The LLVM target bodies have no residual opaque XXH calls.
